name: partner-store-onboarding-publication
objective: Re-prove the implemented field-originated partner/store onboarding and publication path end to end on one store.
truthOwner: DSH owns onboarding/store operational truth; partner/control/client surfaces only participate in the bounded field-originated workflow.

tasks.objective: Re-prove the field-originated partner/store onboarding and publication path on one canonical store identity.
tasks.currentProblem: Historical U004 PASS predates current BB and cannot prove present cross-surface state convergence.
tasks.requiredChange: Run same-store field-to-operator-to-partner-to-client scenarios and repair only reproduced DSH state/readback divergence.
tasks.targetState: One store identity moves through authorized onboarding/review/publication states with consistent bounded readback and no premature public visibility.
tasks.action: Create or reuse a field onboarding candidate, exercise evidence/retry/review, then verify partner and client state using the same canonical IDs.
mustNotChange: Do not create surface-local publication truth.
Do not bypass review/readiness to force public visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner readback matches canonical store state.
Client visibility matches publication/readiness gates for the same store.
tasks.rollback: Revert only a focused reproduced-defect fix; preserve canonical DSH store identity and historical evidence.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused onboarding/publication commit only if current verification reproduces a defect.
